en: The image is of a decorated vintage postcard featuring an ornate floral Art Nouveau border with pink roses and heart-shaped leaves. Within the border, there is a black-and-white photograph of a square with a prominent domed building with a cross on top and a tall tower beside it. The square also contains a fountain or monument and several surrounding historic buildings. Hills are visible in the background. There is printed text in Hungarian on the left side and at the bottom of the photograph.
